title: Async autosave, unload flushes, map and player writes (no main-thread save spikes)
player_outcome: The game no longer freezes every 2 minutes at autosave or when walking away from built areas. Saving happens in the background.
design: Checked in code: GameWorld.Tick calls SaveAll() synchronously every 7200 ticks (GameWorld.cs:114, :246-249). It encodes every modified chunk, rewrites region files, serializes player JSON, and deflates each explored map (ExploredMap.Save, Deflate Optimal over 64×64×8-byte tiles, iterating with a LINQ Concat) on the main thread. The map deflate is a spike source the audit did not list. ChunkStreamer.Unload encodes on main (WorldSession.Unload → Encode).

GameWorld.cs is 387 lines, so move the save code to a new partial src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.Saving.cs: SaveAll (sync), BeginAutosave (async), SavePlayer, WritePlayer, LoadOrCreatePlayer, DeletePlayer, PlayerPath, Shutdown.

BeginAutosave, timed as tick.autosave: Events.Persist and Town.Persist on main; Session.BeginSave capture; PlayerSave.From(state).Serialize() on main with the file writes queued; Maps.QueueSave(saver). Raise Autosaved(chunks) from the batch's Done callback on main. If the previous autosave is still in flight, retry on a later tick.

MapSystem: add QueueSave(WorldSaver). Per player map with Dirty set (set in ExploredMap reveal and write paths, cleared on queue): ExploredMap.Snapshot() deep-copies tile arrays (~32 KB memcpy per tile), and the saver job runs snapshot.Save(blockName) on the worker. Keep Save() synchronous for tests.

ChunkStreamer.Unload: WorldSession.Unload returns ChunkSnapshot? (capture instead of encode). _pendingSaves becomes List<ChunkSnapshot>. FlushSaves enqueues a batch without blocking. UnloadAll enqueues and then calls Saver.Flush().
Shutdown (from WorldRuntime._ExitTree): wait for the in-flight save, then synchronous SaveAll and UnloadAll (blocking on exit is fine). PauseMenu 'Save & Quit' keeps the synchronous SaveAll.
BuiltinCommands `save`: add `save async` for perf.cmds; plain `save` stays synchronous for existing smoke scripts.
perf.cmds: add `save async`, wait 1, `assert perf.max.tick.autosave < 8` and `assert perf.max.stream.unload_flush < 4` (generous headless bounds).
docs/architecture/persistence.md: async saving, pending snapshots, single writer, meta written after blobs.
files_modify: src/Strata.Core/Session/GameWorld.cs — autosave calls BeginAutosave; save code moved out (stays under 400 lines)
game/UI/PauseMenu.cs — keep sync save on quit (verify)
tests: AsyncSaveTests.AutosaveCaptureIsCheap: TestGame with 50 modified chunks; BeginAutosave main-thread time < 15 ms; after Flush a fresh session reloads identical chunks, player file and map file
AsyncSaveTests.RestreamBeforeWriteKeepsEdits: edit, move focus away (unload with gated worker), move back, and the edit is present
Existing tests that call SaveAll or UnloadAll pass unchanged
verification: dotnet test; all smoke scripts; menu tour
Rendering run of perf.cmds: `perf spikes` has no tick.autosave or stream.unload_flush entries (baseline from P1b-05 had them)
Manual: play past an autosave with F3 open (spike line stays clean); quit during an autosave and reload
risks: Autosave overlapping shutdown: Shutdown must wait before its final synchronous save
Map Dirty flag must be set on every reveal path, or maps go unsaved
Lost (dead hardcore) players must still be skipped
Shares ChunkStreamer.Scheduling.cs and ChunkStreamer.cs with P1b-08: sequence
